description: Required and forbidden contents of a Release Ikkoku.app (T-T02). Read by Tools/verification/inspect_app_bundle.py. Every rule names why it exists; keep the lists in step with Ikkoku.xcodeproj and the runtime lookups they cite (test_inspect_app_bundle.py checks the Xcode-derived lists).

executable.why: The port targets Apple Silicon only. Every Mach-O file in the bundle must contain these slices.

required.why: GPUContext.makeShaderLibrary loads IkkokuShaders.metallib from Bundle.main only; Renderer init fails without it. There is no source-tree shader fallback.
EngineHost.locateAssets uses Bundle.main.resourceURL only when catalog.json is there; otherwise it falls back to the build checkout's Assets/ (unless IKKOKU_SOURCE_TREE_FALLBACKS=0).

ignoredKeys.regionsFile: Declared by Catalog.swift but never read at runtime; the .bin files are git-ignored generator intermediates.

catalog.why: AssetLibrary resolves catalog paths against the assets root, and bare texture names under Textures/ (AssetLibrary.texture). Every referenced model, mask and texture must be in the bundle.

assets.why: The IkkokuCreator target copies the Assets/ folder as a file-system synchronized group: explicitFolders keep their subfolder, other files land directly in Resources, and the excluded test fixtures are membership exceptions. A synchronized group copies whatever is on disk, so a bundle file is accepted as an asset only when it is a git-tracked Assets file.

buildProducts.why: IkkokuShaders target product, copied by Copy Bundle Resources.
App icon generated from the asset catalog.
Localized resources generated by Xcode, if any.
Swift back-deployment libraries Xcode embeds for older deployment targets, if any.
Provisioning profile of a signed build.

forbidden.why: The git-ignored .local/ tree holds original game data, recovered source, private cards/scenes and captures (CONTRIBUTING.md).
Build output, caches and debug symbols (.gitignore) are not app resources.
Directory names of the original installation, its mods and the .local/reverse recovery tree.

Repository source, including the Engine package's tests and their fixtures, is compiled or used by tools, never read from the bundle. The first CI Release build (2026-10-23) found all 247 Packages/ files under Contents/Resources/Engine/ because the app target listed Packages/ as a synchronized group.
Recovered or decompiled C#/IL and original Unity shader source belong to isolated analysis tooling.
Original game, Unity or plugin assemblies (any file with a PE header counts, whatever its name).
Original Unity asset bundles and serialized files (any file with an asset-bundle signature counts, whatever its name).
Local mod archives and other packed inputs.
Original character cards and Studio scenes are PNGs with a payload after IEND; their keywords must not appear in resource data.

pathScan.why: Absolute build-machine paths and .local/ references in Info.plist, text resources, PNG text chunks and GLB JSON chunks fail. Compiled build products (the executable, metallib, Assets.car) are only counted: Swift 5 #file/#filePath strings embed the checkout path in the executable by design.
